stances_toward.note: Claimed, not controlled: Russia and the local authorities hold Abkhazia since the 1992-93 war and Moscow's 2008 recognition; Tbilisi does not recognise it and calls it occupied, and Western governments repeat the 20%-occupied figure. The claim is frozen (no force, no policy to retake it). Direct Moscow-Sukhumi flights resumed in May 2025 over Georgian protests; a Russian-built customs terminal in Gali was reported in December 2025 and Kobakhidze denied Georgian involvement. Bond grievance: the 1992-93 war and its displacement. Mirrors the objective row.

stances_toward.note: Recognised by decree No. 1260 on 26 Aug 2008, embassy-level relations since 9 Sep 2008, a joint military base under the 2010 agreement (49 years, renewable), a 2012 trade agreement; Moscow's recognition is the reason there is no Russian-Georgian dialogue. Ally: a protectorate whose budget and defence are Russian. Bond - affinity, not kin: Moscow protects a non-Russian people as a lever on Tbilisi.
